newsitem.title: USA: Maytag to repurchase additional shares.
newsitem.headline: Maytag to repurchase additional shares.

text.p: Maytag Corp, the home appliance, floor care product and vending equipment maker, said Thursday its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of an additional 15 million shares of common stock, extending a current repurchase program.
The 15 million is in addition to a previous 15.8 million repurchase authorization, Maytag said. About 11.4 million shares have been repurchased under that plan, Maytag said.
At the end of April, Maytag had about 97.7 million shares outstanding.
The share repurchase programs will be conducted over an extended period of time and repurchases will be made on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions, Maytag said.
Maytag shares were down 1/4 at 23-3/4 Thursday.
